title: Final Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for the minimum energy approximation.

title: Normalization Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive and apply the normalization condition for the trial function.

title: Hamiltonian Expectation Value
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly compute the expectation value of the Hamiltonian using the trial function.

title: Use of Integrals
description: Important Criteria: The student should appropriately utilize the provided integrals in their calculations.

title: Inequality Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the inequality to derive the minimum energy condition.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign errors in the Hamiltonian expectation value calculation.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should check for any missing factors in the final expression for energy.
